source: Dallas City Code ch. 51P, Article 236 (City Attorney's codified article, April 2026)

sections.title: Article heading
sections.text:
ARTICLE 236.

PD 236.

sections.title: Legislative History
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.101. LEGISLATIVE HISTORY.

PD 236 was established by Ordinance No. 19165, passed by the Dallas City Council on May 21, 1986. Ordinance No. 19165 amended Ordinance No. 10962, Chapter 51 of the Dallas City Code, as amended. (Ord. Nos. 10962; 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Property Location And Size
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.102. PROPERTY LOCATION AND SIZE.

PD 236 is established on property generally located at the northeast corner of Mountain Lake Road and Merrifield Road. The size of PD 236 is approximately 168.26 acres. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Definitions And Interpretations
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.103. DEFINITIONS AND INTERPRETATIONS.

(a) Unless otherwise stated, the definitions and interpretations in Chapter 51 apply to this article.

(b) Unless otherwise stated, all references to articles, divisions, or sections in this article are to articles, divisions, or sections in Chapter 51. (Ord. 25711)

sections.title: Conceptual Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.104. CONCEPTUAL PLAN.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the city plan commission-approved conceptual plan (Exhibit 236A). The conceptual plan divides the Property into several tracts. References in this article to a particular tract are references to that tract as described on the conceptual plan. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Development Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.105. DEVELOPMENT PLAN.

(a) Generally. A development plan for the Property or some portion thereof must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission within 12 months of May 21, 1986. No building permit may be issue until a development plan is approved on that portion of the tract for which a permit is sought.

(b) Requisites. The development plan must include the site plan requisites listed in Section 51-4.803(d).

(c) CPC action. In deciding whether to approve or deny the development plan, the city plan commission shall follow the standards set out for the director of development services in Section 51- 4.803. The city plan commission in reviewing the development plan shall make one of the following decisions:

(1) Approval, no conditions.

(2) Approval, subject to conditions noted.

(3) Denial. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Landscape Plan
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.106. LANDSCAPE PLAN.

A landscape plan in accordance with Article X must be submitted to and approved by the city plan commission for Tracts 1, 2, and 5 or portions thereof upon which a request is made for a building permit. No building permit may issue until a landscape plan is approved on the portion of the tract for which a building permit is sought. Landscaping plans may be submitted to cover only the portion of the Property for which a building permit is sought. The landscaping must be installed in accordance with the approved landscape plan prior to the issuance of a certificate of occupancy for any structure on the tract or portion thereof. No landscaping plans are required for Tracts 3, 4, and 6. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Uses, Floor Area Ratio, Height, And Density For
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.107. USES, FLOOR AREA RATIO, HEIGHT, AND DENSITY FOR TRACT 1.

(a) Uses. The following uses are the only uses permitted on Tract 1.

(1) Those bar and restaurant uses permitted in an NS Neighborhood Service District.

(2) Those professional, personal service, and custom craft uses permitted in an NS Neighborhood Service District.

(3) Those retail uses permitted in an NS Neighborhood Service District.

(b) FAR. Maximum permitted floor area ratio on Tract 1 is 0.4:1.

(c) Height. No structure may exceed 24 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Uses, Floor Area Ratio, Height, And Density For
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.108. USES, FLOOR AREA RATIO, HEIGHT, AND DENSITY FOR TRACT 2.

(a) Uses. The only permitted uses on Tract 2 is multiple-family.

(b) Density. No more than 18 dwelling units per acre nor more than a total of 643 dwelling units are permitted on Tract 2.

(c) Height. No structure may exceed 36 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Uses, Floor Area Ratio, Height, And Density For
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.109. USES, FLOOR AREA RATIO, HEIGHT, AND DENSITY FOR TRACT 3.

(a) Uses. The only permitted use on Tract 3 is single-family.

(b) Density. No more than nine dwelling units per acre nor more than a total of 330 dwelling units are permitted on Tract 3.

(c) Height. No structure may exceed 30 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Uses, Floor Area Ratio, Height, And Density For
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.110. USES, FLOOR AREA RATIO, HEIGHT, AND DENSITY FOR TRACT 4.

(a) Uses. The only permitted use on Tract 4 is single-family.

(b) Density. No more than six dwelling units per acre nor more than a total of 259 dwelling units are permitted on Tract 4.

(c) Height. No structure may exceed 30 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Uses, Floor Area Ratio, Height, And Density For
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.111. USES, FLOOR AREA RATIO, HEIGHT, AND DENSITY FOR TRACT 5.

(a) Uses. The only permitted use on Tract 5 is multiple-family.

(b) Density. No more than 18 dwelling units per acre nor more than a total of 257 dwelling units are permitted on Tract 5.

(c) Height. No structure may exceed 36 feet in height. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Uses, Floor Area Ratio, Height, And Density For
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.112. USES, FLOOR AREA RATIO, HEIGHT, AND DENSITY FOR TRACT 6.

(a) Uses. The only permitted use on Tract 6 is multiple-family.

(b) Density. No more than nine dwelling units per acre nor more than a total of 282 dwelling units are permitted on Tract 6.

(c) Height. No structure may exceed 30 feet in height.

(d) Attachment limitation. No building may contain more than four dwelling units. No dwelling unit may be constructed on top of another dwelling unit. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Building Setbacks
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.113. BUILDING SETBACKS.

Minimum setbacks for development on the Property are as follows:

(1) Tract 1. All structures on Tract 1 must comply with the minimum setbacks of an NS Neighborhood Service District.

(2) Tracts 2 and 5. Development on each lot in Tracts 2 and 5 must observe the following minimum yard requirements:

(A) Front - 15 feet.

(B) Side - 10 feet.

(C) Rear - 15 feet.

(3) Tracts 3, 4, and 6. No setbacks are required on these three tracts. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Lot Coverage
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.114. LOT COVERAGE.

Maximum permitted lot coverage on the Property is as follows:

(1) Tract 1. Forty percent.

(2) Tracts 2, 3, 4, 5, and 6. Maximum permitted coverage is 60 percent on each tract except that on Tracts 3 and 4, coverage of a lot is permitted up to 80 percent if the total coverage on the tract does not exceed 60 percent and at least 40 percent of the tract is reserved for open space. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Off-Street Parking
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.115. OFF-STREET PARKING.

Off-street parking on the Property must be provided in accordance with the provisions of the Dallas Development Code. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Signs
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.116. SIGNS.

All signs on the Property must comply with the provisions for non-business zoning districts contained in Article VII. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: General Requirements
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.117. GENERAL REQUIREMENTS.

Utilization of the Property must comply with the requirements of all other applicable codes, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Paving
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.118. PAVING.

All paved areas, permanent drives, streets, and drainage structures, if any, must be constructed in accordance with standard city specifications, and completed to the satisfaction of the director of public works and transportation. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Compliance With Conditions
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.119. COMPLIANCE WITH CONDITIONS.

The building official shall not issue a building permit or certificate of occupancy for a use in this PD until there has been full compliance with this article, the Dallas Development Code, the construction codes, and all other applicable ordinances, rules, and regulations of the city. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)

sections.title: Zoning Map
sections.text:
SEC. 51P-236.120. ZONING MAP.

PD 236 is located on Zoning Map No. M-4. (Ord. Nos. 19165; 25711)
